packages/shared/src/design.ts:CONTRAST_R: The WCAG AA floor. accessibility-promises.test.ts computes the real ratio from the real hex values for all eight reading pairs and fails below it. There is no request during which a contrast ratio is consulted.
packages/shared/src/design.ts:CONTRAST_T: Names the level each mode targets. The same test converts AAA to 7:1 and measures it. Finding that light-mode secondary text sat at 5.63:1 is what this check was for.
packages/shared/src/design.ts:MAX_FLASH_: WCAG 2.3.1 seizure limit. The test walks every repeating animation in globals.css and fails any that completes faster.
packages/shared/src/design.ts:TARGET_SIZ: Touch target floor. Asserted against the --jm-target-* properties in the shipped stylesheet.
packages/shared/src/design.ts:STATUS_LAB: WCAG 1.4.1 — colour is never the only carrier. The test fails any status colour with no words defined for it.
packages/shared/src/design.ts:CHART_PROH: Five things a graph must not do. Three are checkable against charts.tsx and are checked; the other two are judgement and stay as prose.
packages/shared/src/design.ts:DARK: The dark palette. Measured for contrast and asserted against the --jm-*-d properties, so the stylesheet and the specification cannot drift.
packages/shared/src/design.ts:RADII: Shape scale. Emitted as --jm-radius-* and asserted equal, which is what makes this table the source rather than a parallel opinion.
packages/shared/src/design.ts:SPACING: Spacing scale. Emitted as --jm-space-* and asserted equal.
packages/shared/src/design.ts:MOTION_MS: Motion durations. Emitted as --jm-motion-* and asserted equal.
packages/shared/src/design.ts:TYPEFACES: Type families. Emitted as --jm-type-* and asserted equal.
packages/shared/src/agents.ts:isToolPerm: Guards AGENT_REGISTRY.toolAllowList. Nothing calls it because nothing calls a tool — the gateway has no tool-calling path at all. unwired-spec.test.ts fails the moment one appears, so whoever adds it must route through this on that commit.
packages/shared/src/billing.ts:weakestPl: Reports the thinnest plan. money-integrity.test.ts asserts every plan clears 4x and uses this to name the weakest. A margin is a build-time property of the price table, not a runtime one.
packages/shared/src/ai-costs.ts:realised: Computes revenue over direct cost for a call. money-integrity.test.ts measures every model on the chain against COST_PROTECTION_MULTIPLE with it. Nothing consults it during a request because the 4x is already inside acusForTokens.
packages/shared/src/economics.ts:TARGET_: Derived from PROFIT_MULTIPLE. economics.test.ts asserts the relationship holds, which is the whole content of the constant.
packages/shared/src/growth.ts:PAYOUT_ABO: Its own comment calls it a sanity check: the payout floor must sit above MIN_TRANSACTION_GBP. That is an arithmetic relationship between two constants and belongs in a test.
packages/body-command/src/agents.ts:supe: Its own comment says 'asserted in tests'. Exactly one agent may hold supervisory authority — a property of the registry, checked when the registry changes.
packages/shared/src/brand.ts:MUST_NEVER_: Its own comment says it is kept in code as a review checklist. It is prose for a human reviewer, and the test asserts it has not been silently emptied.
